description: Skill node effect text with base amounts in {braces} (shown as amount x power) and the design power before the per-class scale. 'scale': false nodes are never rescaled (roots, rules, chances, actions). Applied by Scripts/skill-tree-tune.py.

b-age1: +{8}% damage per equipped Barbarian item, per skill rank.
b-blood: Mace connects heal {0.5}% of max HP per rank.
b-wrath: BONE WRATH also heals {1}% max HP per RAGE, per rank.
b-stun: Crit with a Mace: 35% chance to Stun for 1 turn.
b-empty: +{25} STR for each empty action slot, per skill rank.
b-puberty: Rite of passage: +{1} Strength per level.
b-kin: Each equipped Bone / Steel / Iron piece adds +{1} STR per rank.
b-gut: Every 5 effective INT adds +{1} STR to Mace actions, per rank.
b-synth: Every 20 STR adds +{1} to each RAGE / CRISIS / TRIUMPH mint, per rank.
b-scar: Battle Scarred / New / Masterwork pieces: +{10}% Barbarian damage per matching piece, per skill rank.
b-knuckle: While Harden is active, Mace hits gain +{3}% damage per rank.
w-age1: +{8}% speed per equipped Warrior item, per skill rank.
w-lvl2: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% speed on your next action.
w-metronome: Combo slot 2 Sword hits gain +{4}% action speed per rank.
w-cadence: Alternating actions above and below base speed grants +{1} Focus per rank.
w-drum: DRUM CUT: +{2}% speed per BEAT, per rank.
w-phalanx: While Fortify is active, Sword hits gain +{2}% damage per rank.
w-wind: Ending a combo without missing heals {8}% max HP per rank and converts leftover Focus into Fortify.
w-kin: Each equipped Bronze / Gold / Mithril piece adds +{1} AGI per rank.
w-march: Sword actions gain +{1} effective AGI per rank.
w-synth: Every 20 AGI adds +{1} to each BEAT / DRAG / STREAK mint, per rank.
w-hitagi: Hit with a Sword: +{5} Agility for the turn, per skill rank.
w-streak: +{5} Agility for each consecutive attack (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.
w-polish: Worn / Like New / Heirloom pieces: +{10}% Warrior damage per matching piece, per skill rank.
w-flowcrest: MITHRIL FLOW grants {0.34} Focus per STREAK, per rank.
r-age1: +{8}% damage per equipped Rogue item, per skill rank.
r-lvl2: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% damage on your next action.
r-shatter: GLASS NICK applies {0.34} Vulnerability per GRAZE, per rank.
r-grease: Connecting on a natural roll of 7 or lower grants +{1} temporary Technique per rank.
r-kin: Each equipped Glass / Obsidian / Shadow piece adds +{1} TEC per rank.
r-synth: Every 20 TEC adds +{1} to each GRAZE / SWING / TROPHY mint, per rank.
r-aim: Every 25 TEC also lowers your crit threshold by {1}.
r-combo: +{0.5} Combo (lower combo threshold) per Rogue tag on gear and strip, whole steps.
r-cut: Hits apply +{1} Bleed per rank (doubled on crit).
r-toxin: Hits against Poisoned enemies apply +{1} Bleed per rank.
r-mastery: Multihit Dagger actions add +{1} Bleed per extra hit.
z-age1: +{8}% AMP per equipped Wizard item, per skill rank.
z-comboInt: Combo with a Wand: +{5} Intelligence for the turn, per skill rank.
z-soft: Spell hits bank +{2}% damage onto your next hero roll per rank.
z-memory: Repeating a tag adds +{12}% AMP per rank; changing tags cashes the stack (+{12}% per stack per rank).
z-chaos: Combo actions gain +{7}% AMP per empty strip slot.
z-lash: WILLOW LASH: +{3}% AMP per CHAIN, per rank.
z-lvl2: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% AMP on your next hit.
z-lens: Spell/Wand actions gain +{1} effective TEC per rank.
z-odds: Natural rolls of 15+ grant +{1} temporary Intelligence per rank.
z-refract: REFRACT grants {0.5} Focus per LENS, per rank.
z-kin: Each equipped Willow / Silver / Crystal piece adds +{1} INT per rank.
z-weave: Wand actions gain +{2}% AMP per 10 INT, per rank.
z-synth: Every 20 INT adds +{1} to each CHAIN / LENS / CONTACT mint, per rank.
z-archmage: INT's bonus to your status durations gains +{100}%.
z-combo: +{0.5} Combo (lower combo threshold) per Wizard tag on gear and strip, whole steps.
z-bleed: Spell/Wand connects restore {0.5}% of max HP per rank.
z-sigil: Hits against Burning enemies gain +{3}% damage per rank.
z-slotInt: +{5} INT per current action slot (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.
z-resonate: RESONATE: +{2}% damage per CONTACT, per rank.
